## 更新内容

- **两个清晰的下载入口：**此仓库专注 Obsidian 插件，Chrome / Edge 扩展迁入 [browser-ai-inbox](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox)。
- **更容易上手：**新增独立中英文介绍、保存效果图和使用指南，集中说明图片位置、编辑保护和内容设置。
- 保存行为保持一致：思考摘要与正文标题默认关闭，图片沿用 Obsidian 附件设置，本地修改后另存带日期的新笔记。

通过 BRAT 更新 `elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox`。无需重新安装或清空 `data.json`，已有连接继续使用。兼容浏览器扩展 **0.3.0+**，本次无需同时更新另一端。

## What's new

- A dedicated Obsidian release; the Chrome / Edge extension now lives in [browser-ai-inbox](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox).
- Separate English and Chinese introductions, a saved-note preview, and a focused user guide.
- Existing save behavior is preserved: optional thinking and body title default off, images follow attachment settings, and local edits produce a dated copy.

Update `elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox` through BRAT. Keep your existing plugin data and pairing. Compatible with browser extension **0.3.0+**; no companion update is required.

Alpha · Desktop Obsidian 1.12.0+ · Manual installation: `main.js` and `manifest.json`.
